definitions: The lowest load-bearing part of a building, typically below ground level.
An underlying basis or principle for something.
An institution established with an endowment for charitable, educational, or other purposes.
A cosmetic applied to the face as a base for other make-up.
A women's undergarment designed to shape the figure.
examples: The foundation of the house was laid last week.
Trust is the foundation of any good relationship.
The Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation supports global health initiatives.
She applied her foundation before her eyeshadow.
Many women used to wear a foundation garment.
